read_scope: All four original PDF pages visually inspected; numerical observations below transcribed from Table I on printed page 1141.
kinetic_boundary: Reported mean transformation rates are not elementary or first-order rate constants. Lactone-starting hydrolysis observations cannot be relabeled as acid-starting lactonization rates. No plant compartment or physiological kinetic parameter is inferred.

additional_findings.finding: The authors report that lactone-starting aqueous solutions took nearly ten weeks to reach equilibrium at room temperature; the numerical room temperature is not specified in that passage.

additional_findings.location: printed page 1142, section IV and Table II
additional_findings.finding: Mineral-acid experiments add an equivalent amount of sulfuric acid and accelerate equilibration. These conditions are not assigned to Cannabis tissue.

identity_review.catalog_product_depiction: Open aldehyde side chain attached to the lactone ring
identity_review.required_check: Resolve cyclic/open-chain and anomeric equilibrium explicitly; do not merge by glucuronolactone name or formula.

decision: Retain primary evidence for aqueous nonenzymatic interconversion, but do not promote this exact catalog reaction into the candidate-enzyme baseline. Exact identity bridging and plant-relevant conditions remain unresolved.
proposed_test: Compare authentic exact-identity standards in enzyme-free and tissue-matrix controls at measured tissue pH and temperature, following time-dependent acid/lactone and cyclic/open-chain species. Include preparation and storage controls to distinguish ex vivo interconversion from endogenous formation.
other_source_status: The 1968 phosphate-buffer paper remains abstract-only; its full PDF was not retrieved in this review.
